note: RCE-027. Every rule here is checked by `pnpm memory security-audit`; a rule that cannot be checked is a comment, not a policy.

secretRedaction.detail: Configuration and environment analysis records the key name, file and line. The assigned value is never read into a fact, an evidence row, telemetry or a snapshot.

repositoryAccess.detail: Only repositories listed in the registry are read. Analysis stays inside the repository root, skips the configured distDir and node_modules, and never follows a path outside it.

aiExtraction.detail: AI-produced memories must carry producer != 'deterministic', a quality score, and evidence. Normal indexing and retrieval never call an external model.

telemetry.detail: Question text is stored only when MEMORY_TELEMETRY_QUERY_TEXT=1. Fact content, evidence excerpts and configuration values are never stored.

audit.cadence: every sync run and before any rollout gate
audit.failureMode: a failing invariant blocks the rollout gate (RCE-028/029), it does not merely warn
